reviews.text: The most delicious meats in all of riverside!
What to say about this place. Try it yourself and be the Judge. 10/10

We arrived ready for steak but accidentally brought the entire circus. Our kids were loud, chaotic and completely un-medium-rare, yet the staff handled us with incredible patience and never made us feel like a mis-steak. They were so kind and relaxed that we actually managed to eat our meals while they were still hot—which, as parents, is a rare achievement! The steak was beautifully cooked, the service was well done, and nobody had beef with our feral little dinner companions. We left full, grateful and only slightly embarrassed. We’ll definitely be back—possibly with leashes. 😂

Have been a returning customer for many years. Food is always fantastic and have recently received a nice gesture from the team after an earlier mix up. Look forward to coming back in the near future.

Went to El Quincho for lunch today! The food was amazing! The Staff were great! We ended up getting the sharing platter, every meat type was amazing! The beef melted in your mouth, the pork belly was so soft, the chicken was seasoned beautifully, the sausage was so yummy. We will definitely be back.
